name: Wall
description:
**Conversation Summary**

1. The Wall (activity feed) was reworked to aggregate activity from all projects (temporarily reading the first 3 projects via `$api.chats.list()`), sorted newest-first, with the composer using a `ProjectDetailt` (iconify) picker to choose the target project for new posts.
2. An "Unread" selector was added, and the filtering bug was fixed by adding the missing `unreadOnly` option to `filterPosts` (which now filters posts with `unreadCount > 0`).
3. The home title was changed from "Activity" to "Welcome [user name]", and audio notes were added: recording via `MediaRecorder`, stored as base64 `audio/*` `ChatAttachment`s, with playback in the composer preview and feed cards.
4. The file-browsing behavior was fixed by using `accept="image/*,audio/*"` with **no** `capture` attribute, so the OS picker opens albums/Downloads instead of the camera.
5. The desktop layout was fixed by converting viewport media queries (`md:`/`lg:`/`xl:`) to **container queries** (`@xl`/`@5xl`/`@7xl`), ensuring exactly one navigation surface (rail or bottom bar) is always rendered, with the bottom bar anchored to the Wall pane and rail items given `title`/`aria-label`/`aria-current`.
